release_notes: YouTube Manager Analytics is now a long-form Growth Autopilot dashboard instead of being dominated by Shorts.
The main table now shows full-video category, views per day, average percentage viewed, watch minutes, subscriber gain, Growth score and Winner/Healthy/Packaging rescue/Weak topic status.
The recommendation card now shows the actual next full-video category Growth Autopilot would choose and explains the performance signal behind that choice.
Summary cards now focus on full-video growth: videos scored, 28-day full-video views/likes/comments and the top category by Growth score.
Refresh waits for both public YouTube statistics and richer Analytics Autopilot data so the growth dashboard remains the final visible state.
Existing Growth Autopilot category steering, A/B rescue-package preparation, playlists, promos, tracking, website preparation and scheduling remain automatic.
